card.text: A star 35% of the Sun's width that turns once in 1.06 days, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Morin et al. give it 0.35 solar radii, 0.39 solar masses, a rotation period of 1.06 days and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2006-08.title: Radial field, Aug 2006
radial-field-2006-08.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.

brightness-sector-56.title: Brightness map, Sector 56
brightness-sector-56.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

brightness-sector-83.title: Brightness map, Sector 83
brightness-sector-83.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Sep 2024
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
